decisions.reason: As the strategic flagship for cloud transactional email, its option value remains high and keeping costs are low despite some uncertainty resolution.
The dedicated document capture service still has unresolved niche value and no negative results, so it remains cheap to hold.
Email/fax conversion is a low-cost legacy bridge with limited strategic upside, so its drop probability rises as demand trends become clearer.
Multi-engine virus scanning is close to the existing offer and security demand keeps it viable, but as a marginal feature it faces moderate drop risk.
